market_today.lead: AI spending is still the engine.
market_today.body: The AI infrastructure buildout keeps compounding — record memory-test revenue, book-to-bill above 2, and data-center names raising guidance. Tech picks like XLK and newcomers WST and IDT are riding real order books, not multiple expansion.

market_today.lead: Boring businesses are earning their keep.
market_today.body: The top of the stock list is full of unglamorous compounders — asset managers, industrial suppliers, a REIT, an occupational-health chain. In a market priced for perfection, steady cash flow is doing the quiet work.

The 10-year Treasury sits at a 24-year high near 5.3%, which means safe bonds pay enough to compete with stocks for investor money. Growth names are priced for perfection against that backdrop — any earnings miss gets punished.

market_today.lead: Oil is still the wild card.
market_today.body: Month seven of the US-Iran conflict with Hormuz constrained and Brent near $100. OPEC meets today and the G-7 just released reserves. An escalation reprices inflation expectations and with them the entire rate outlook.

Two markets in one: AI capex and steady compounders are working, while rates and oil keep everyone honest. The new momentum treatment is doing its job — today's list favors sustained trends over last month's spikes.
